question: The Karni Mata temple in Deshnok (Deshnoke), Rajasthan is famous for the ______ that live, and are revered, in the temple.
solution:
The correct answer is __**rats.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Karni Mata Temple in Rajasthan is called 'Temple of Rats'.
 
• ​Karni Mata Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Karni Mata at Deshnoke, Bikaner, Rajasthan.
 
• It is also known as the Temple of Rats.
